course_name_original: Introducción y manejo del programa mathematica
course_name_en: Introduction and use of the Mathematica program

learning_outcomes.text: Handle the Mathematica program for solving mathematical problems.
Learn to use Mathematica's graphical capabilities.
Learn the programming fundamentals of the Mathematica program to solve different numerical problems by implementing the corresponding algorithm.
That students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge specific to the subject area.

That students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional way and possess the competences that are usually demonstrated by elaborating and defending arguments and solving problems within their area of study.
That students can transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to a specialized and non-specialized audience.
Handle the Mathematica program for problem solving.

syllabus_topics: Linear algebra with Mathematica: lists, vectors, and matrix calculus
Calculus with Mathematica: functions, derivatives, integrals, and differential equations
Numerical calculus with Mathematica: numerical resolution of equations, Data fitting and interpolation

assessment_methods.method: Presentation of a final project with questions from the professor

assessment_rules: The assessment will be based on the completion of assignments. Active class participation will be considered in the final grade. The evaluation system includes theoretical and practical assignments throughout the course and the presentation of a final project, during which the professor will ask questions. The evaluation procedures measure the achievement of the course objectives.
